ops.comment: Dec escorting neutrals out of lift

int.text: Oh look. The welcome wagon.

fra.text: Regardez, voilà le comité d'accueil.

int.text: Ambush their ambush. I like it!
There they are!
Megatron -- when this is over, can I rip off Starscream's head and boot it into space? Please?

fra.text: Megatron... Quand tout ça sera fini, je pourrai lui arracher la tête et la jeter dans l'espace, s'il te plait ?

int.text: Hit RX 5
Snipers on the bridge, Megatron!

fra.text: Tireurs d'élite sur le pont, Megatron !

int.text: The damage looks...old. It's been this way for a good while. But no weapon I know of could've done this.
Dark Energon did all of THIS?

fra.text: C'est l'énergon noir qui a fait ÇA ?

int.text: I can feel the power!

fra.text: Je peux sentir sa puissance !

int.text: There is no exhaust coming from that vent.  We can blast through to make an entrance!

fra.text: Ce conduit d'aération n'a pas l'air d'être utilisé. On pourrait essayer de passer par là !

int.text: We're lucky to have survived that, Megatron.

fra.text: On a de la chance d'être encore entier, Megatron.

int.text: Fat chance. We can use that crane to reach the crash tunnel and flank them.

fra.text: Pas de chance. On peut utiliser cette grue pour atteindre le tunnel du crash et les contourner !

int.text: This is almost too easy.

fra.text: C'est presque trop facile...

int.text: Huh--and we're fresh out of Star Cruisers to tunnel our way.

fra.text: Hmm... et plus de croiseur stellaire pour nous servir de bélier.

int.text: These Cubes seem terribly outdated.

fra.text: Cette technologie est complètement dépassée...

int.text: So--what exactly did they manufacture here?

fra.text: Alors... qu'est-ce qu'ils fabriquaient ici, exactement ?

int.text: Aren't you concerned at all driving into the belly of a furnace?

fra.text: Ça ne vous inquiète pas de rouler comme ça dans un haut fourneau ?

int.text: Melee Attack RX 4
Wow...that's a pretty long drop.

fra.text: Hmm... ça fait une sacrée chute.

int.text: This place is pretty active to be thousands of years old.

fra.text: Ces chaînes tournent encore à plein régime, après tout ce temps ?

int.text: Where do we go now, Megatron?

fra.text: Qu'est-ce qu'on fait, maintenant, Megatron ?

int.text: Flyers inbound!

fra.text: Aérobots en approche !

int.text: What makes you think you can control the Dark Energon, when no one else has ever been able to?

fra.text: Qu'est-ce qui te fait croire que tu seras capable de contrôler l'énergon noir, alors que personne n'y est jamais parvenu ?

int.text: Its amazing!

fra.text: C'est extraordinaire !

int.text: See you at the bottom!
But...Megatron...how do we get out?
These soldiers look pretty banged up.

fra.text: Ces minables sont dans un sale état.

int.text: The floor is splitting apart!
I hope this Dark Energon stuff is worth it, Megatron.

fra.text: J'espère que cet énergon noir en vaut vraiment la peine...

int.text: Melee Attack RX 3
Who's next?!

fra.text: À qui le tour ?

int.text: You want more?

fra.text: Tu en veux encore ?

int.text: For the glory of Megatron!

fra.text: Pour la gloire de Megatron !

int.text: Melee Attack RX 2
DIE!!

fra.text: YAAAAAAAARRRGH !

int.text: HEY! KNOCK IT OFF!

fra.text: HÉ ! ÇA SUFFIT, MAINTENANT !

int.text: Pull back! Pull back!

fra.text: Repli général ! En arrière !

int.text: Watch out!
Death RX 8
Death RX 9
Death RX 18
What a waste of metal!

fra.text: Quel gaspillage d'énergon !

int.text: Hit RX 1
Hit RX 2
Hit RX 4
Lord Megatron! The ship's reactor core is failing -- explosion imminent!
The core's about to detonate!

fra.text: Attention, le réacteur va exploser !

int.text: Its falling apart!

fra.text: Éloignez-vous, vite !

int.text: Megatron!  This way!

fra.text: Megatron ! Par ici !

int.text: Over here!
Its Lord Megatron!

fra.text: C'est le seigneur Megatron !

int.text: Take out those sentry guns!  They're tearing us apart!
I HATE those sentry guns!

fra.text: Je DÉTESTE ces tourelles !

int.text: Hail, Lord Megatron!

fra.text: Gloire à Megatron !

int.text: Area is secured, Megatron!

fra.text: Le périmètre est sécurisé, Megatron !

int.text: It's an honor to serve you, Lord Megatron!
They're putting up a good fight, alright.

fra.text: Ils se défendent bien, pas de doute là-dessus.

int.text: Uggggh--I think I'm going offline!

fra.text: Argh... Je crois que je vais déconnecter !

int.text: My name is Jetfire. I'm not here to fight.
I've seen the horrors of what Dark Energon can do, Megatron -- it is not be trifled with! Its power is too unstable...to use it would mean disaster!
Then you are a short-sighted fool. You'll kill us all!
Death RX 4
The intruders are here! Call in reinforcements!
There they are! Move ahead and cut them off in Storage Area Beta! Move! Move!
Starscream!  The ambush is set. They won't make it past us.
Yes, sir!
The strong survive. The weak perish.

fra.text: Les forts survivent. Les faibles périssent.

int.text: MOVE, Decepticons! Double-time!

fra.text: Déployez-vous, Decepticons ! Exécution !

int.text: Go! Go! GO!
I am Megatron, leader of the Decepticons! This space station is Decepticon property! Surrender immediately!
Those fools mean to catch us in an ambush at the next door!

fra.text: Ces imbéciles veulent nous prendre par surprise derrière la porte suivante.

int.text: Transmit your coordinates, Soundwave -- and I want everything ready upon my arrival.
Crush them!

fra.text: Écrasez-les !

int.text: I shall not be denied, Starscream. Surrender your Dark Energon program to me immediately!!
I am COUNTING on it.

fra.text: Exactement ce dont j'ai besoin !

int.text:
Patience, Brawl. Starscream knows this station inside and out. He may 
yet be of use to us.
I expect it done when I arrive, Soundwave!

fra.text: Fais en sorte qu'il soit prêt quand j'arrive, Soundwave !

int.text: Decepticons, mount those turrets!  We'll cut them down with their own weaponry!
Soundwave, report!
Quiet. There must be another access point.... We have to reach the station's next pod!
Then we have no time to waste.
This entire station was created over 10,000 years ago. Much of its technology is antiquated--and inefficient. I look forward to updating it.

Starscream...this acrimony is needless. I know who you once were, Sky Commander, and that you were betrayed. With Dark Energon, I shall return Cybertron to its former glory -- and you to yours -- IF you agree to serve me.
Excellent! Decepticons! Lock this room down and await our return!
Transport devices for Dark Energon. The ancients constructed special pods they could launch to any part of Cybertron.
Aren't YOU concerned that I might tire of your pointless chatter?
Soundwave! We've located the holomap -- I'm sending the data to you now.
Melee Attack RX 1
Jump you fool! There is nowhere to go but down!

fra.text: Saute, idiot ! On doit descendre, il n'y a pas d'autre solution !

int.text: Soundwave reactivated it upon my orders. I have VERY special plans for this facility.
Once I have enough Dark Energon online, I will use these canisters to transport it to Cybertron! The Autobots' surprise will be TOTAL.
Cybertron...

fra.text: Cybertron...

int.text: Yes...this is unexpected. The entire area lies in shambles.
I don't care what did it -- find a way across!
Fascinating! According to this, a quantity of Dark Energon became unstable...and the resulting explosion destroyed this part of the station.
Those fools had no idea how to control it! I'll not make the same mistake!
That makes ONE of us. Speak your piece--quickly.
You cannot frighten me, Jetfire. I will use Dark Energon as I please.
You say that as if it were a bad thing.
Only the strong are worthy of such a weapon, Barricade. I am the strongest.
You shall soon learn, Starscream...*I* decide what is possible and what isn't!
We cannot let Starscream succeed! Do you hear me? I WON'T ALLOW IT!
Quick!  Blast the containment field!

fra.text: Vite ! Détruisez le champ de rétention !

int.text: Hahahaha  I...am the dominator. I...am the destroyer!

fra.text: Je suis ... le dominateur. Je suis... le destructeur !

int.text: Decepticons, receive your birthright!
What?!?

fra.text: Comment !?

int.text: We show them NO mercy!
Your rage befits a Decepticon warrior.

fra.text: Ta fureur fait honneur aux Decepticons !

int.text: Yes -- obliterate them!
Now--I shall deal with Starscream!
Leave nothing but scrap metal!

fra.text: Il n'en reste qu'un tas de ferraille !

int.text: Perfect! Take them all to pieces!

fra.text: Excellent ! Mets-les tous en pièces !

int.text: Do not let that fury subside!

fra.text: Ne laisse pas retomber ta colère !

int.text: Smash them. Crush them. DESTROY THEM.

fra.text: Frappe-les ! Écrase-les ! DÉTRUIS-LES !

int.text: War Cry 2

fra.text: [Cri de guerre 2]

int.text: Find the controls to that service arm!
Are your audio receptors damaged?  I said find the controls to that arm!
Onward!  Through that door!
The fools gave us our exit!

fra.text: Ces idiots nous ont offert une sortie !

int.text: Those fans will split you in two! I can't use you if you're dead!
Stay clear of the fans, you fool!
I am MEGATRON!

fra.text: Je suis MEGATRON !

int.text: The honor is all yours.
Excellent.
Do not speak unless spoken to.
Then put up a BETTER fight!

fra.text: Vous n'êtes que des incapables !

int.text: Unacceptable.  They should be victorious, or dead.

fra.text: Inadmissible. Ils devraient être victorieux, ou désactivés !

int.text: Quickly--jump to the other side!
And do not question me again!

fra.text: Et ne discute plus mes ordres !

int.text: I tire of these futile attempts to resist me.
Dark Energon will be MINE.
Megatron -- Soundwave here. Establishing a forward base.
Alert-- hostiles inbound!
Megatron. We await your arrival.
Megatron. Your command post is 83.4% complete.
Megatron -- I have unlocked the lift controls. Your command center awaits at the top.
We have taken control of this portion of the station and established your base of operations. Scans indicate that Starscream has locked down all logical routes to the Dark Energon reactor.
Megatron -- I have located a nearby Data Matrix Center to reveal any alternate means of entry to the next pod. Advanced teams have already been sent to clear your path.

Megatron -- be aware that you face overwhelming odds against Starscream's soldiers. It is statistically unlikely that your advance teams can defeat all of them. I shall await your word that you have reached the Data Matrix Center.
Megatron -- there is a route through the manufacturing plant nearby that Starscream has not yet blocked. Transmitting coordinates.
Megatron--according to my scans the manufacturing plant is directly below your floor.
Megatron. Starscream is alerted to your presence in the production facility. Expect resistance.
The holomap indicates no damage to this area.

fra.text: L'holocarte ne signale aucun dégât dans cette zone.

int.text: Megatron, I have downloaded the station's log. Transmitting history.

fra.text: Megatron. J'ai téléchargé le journal de la station. Je te transmets les données.

int.text: Whoever you are, you've traveled a long way just to meet your doom!

fra.text: Je ne sais pas qui tu es, mais tu as commis une grosse erreur en venant ici !

int.text: I am Starscream,
I shall hold you to that, soldier.

fra.text: Il vaudrait mieux pour toi, soldat...

int.text: Megatron! I thought you'd be scrap metal by now. Your survival...intrigues me.
Dark Energon...? Are you MAD? Dark Energon brings only death and chaos!
Megatron! You may have gotten this far...but you'll never get your hands on the Dark Energon!
Impossible! No one has ever survived to reach this place!
Guards! Hold him off while I destroy the last of the Dark Energon remnants!
STOP HIM! I need more time to initiate the sequence!
You're too late! I have initiated the destruction sequence!
You arrogant FOOL! No one has ever survived direct contact!
What? This isn't possible!
No! No one can control Dark Energon! It dominates and destroys everything it touches!
You're a fool!  No one can control Dark Energon!
and I have protected my station for over a thousand years!
